candidates.source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: Sole representative body of banks in Slovakia (founded 1993, ~24 members covering ~99-100% of sector assets). Publishes press releases, sector positions, payment-card statistics/analyses, project and standards documents (e.g. push-payment notification standard, ESG frameworks). Primary sector-level disclosure channel for SK banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML crawl of /novinka/ and /projekt/ listing pages plus PDF harvest; SK and EN variants (/en/).
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia výročná správa
Slovak Banking Association members annual report sbaonline.sk

candidates.source_name: SBA — Members list (Zoznam členov / Members)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates the full universe of SK banks and associate members — 20 full members (365.bank, ČSOB, Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, VÚB, Prima banka, mBank, J&T, Komerční banka, UniCredit CZ&SK, Oberbank, BKS, Citibank, ING, PKO BP, Penta Bank, Cofidis, PSS, Wüstenrot, SZRB) plus associates (Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR, Eximbanka, Regional Card Processing Centre, Nexi Group). Each member entry links to the member's own site → seeds A1 IR/disclosure sources. Presence of RCPC and Nexi flags card-processing vendors in-market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parse member list HTML, extract member names + outbound URLs, snowball into per-entity IR/annual-report crawlers.
queries_used: Slovak Banking Association members annual report sbaonline.sk

candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Profesijné združenia (professional associations directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator-curated master list of SK financial-sector self-regulatory bodies with URLs: SBA (+Inštitút ARS), SLASPO, ADDS, ADSS, AFISP, AOCP, APSÚ, Rada pre reklamu, SASS. Highest-authority pointer for this coverage cell — defines the association landscape without guesswork.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off + periodic re-fetch; extract association names and outbound URLs as seed registry.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search, then fetched and parsed
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia výročná správa
bankový ombudsman Slovenská banková asociácia inštitút výročná správa

candidates.source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS SR)
candidates.why_relevant: Leasing association covering ~90% of the SK leasing market; member of Leaseurope. Publishes monthly market indicator statistics for Slovakia and European comparatives — rare sector-level quantitative disclosure for non-bank finance. Also documents (stanovy, etický kódex), press releases and a vehicle register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of /slovensko and /slovak-statistics; watch /tlacove-spravy-informacie for releases.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + direct fetch of navigation
queries_used: Asociácia leasingových spoločností Slovenskej republiky členovia štatistiky ALS SR

candidates.source_name: ALS SR — Riadni a pridružení členovia (member directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Enumerates SK leasing/asset-finance companies (bank-owned captives and independents) plus associated members (vendors, insurers, service providers) — a second actor map layer beyond the banking list.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parse both member pages, extract entity names + URLs, cross-map to registeruz.sk filings.
candidates.discovered_via_method: pointer snowball from association site navigation
queries_used: Asociácia leasingových spoločností Slovenskej republiky členovia štatistiky ALS SR

candidates.source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (Slovak FinTech Association)
candidates.why_relevant: Founded Aug 2018; platform between fintech/payments firms and the regulator. Publishes news, blog, memoranda and legislative commentary, and holds working meetings with NBS (e.g. Feb 2023) and crypto-regulation conferences — a direct channel for fintech/payments sector positions plus a member directory of SK fintechs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/blog/memoranda + member directory pages; low update frequency, monthly cadence sufficient.
queries_used: fintech asociácia Slovensko členovia platobné inštitúcie združenie

candidates.source_name: FINAS — Fintech & Insurtech Asociácia Slovenska
candidates.why_relevant: Second, more recent SK fintech body with tiered membership (corporate, SME, startup up to 3 years, supporters) and an events programme; academic members include Ekonomická univerzita v Bratislave. Its membership page enumerates fintech/insurtech/payments actors including payment institutions — pointer plus sector-voice source. EN mirror at /en/.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /clenstvo/ (members) and /eventy/; snapshot quarterly to track membership churn as a fintech-entry signal.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search snowballed from generic fintech-association query
queries_used: FINAS Fintech Insurtech asociácia Slovenska členovia
fintech asociácia Slovensko členovia platobné inštitúcie združenie

candidates.source_name: Inštitút alternatívneho riešenia sporov SBA (Institute for ADR, SBA)
candidates.why_relevant: SBA-founded ADR body (established 1 July 2018, replacing the abolished bankový ombudsman as of 31 May 2018). Handles consumer disputes from payment services, payment-account switching and banking transactions — its caseload reporting is a leading indicator of consumer friction in payments. Listed by NBS as the SBA's dispute channel.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual check for activity reports/statistics; low-frequency crawl.
queries_used: bankový ombudsman Slovenská banková asociácia inštitút výročná správa

candidates.source_name: SBA Educa — certification/examination body of the Slovak Banking Association
candidates.why_relevant: SBA-affiliated body running statutory examinations for financial intermediaries. Exam volumes, syllabi and regulation-driven curriculum changes are an indirect read on distribution-channel size and on incoming regulatory requirements affecting banks/PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of about/news pages.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search snowball from SBA query
queries_used: Slovenská banková asociácia členovia výročná správa

candidates.source_name: Asociácia obchodníkov s cennými papiermi (AOCP) — securities dealers association
candidates.why_relevant: Non-profit active since 1995; members are the principal SK capital-market firms licensed for investment services, bound by an AOCP Code of Ethics. Its member list (/zoznam.html) enumerates investment-services providers, many of which are bank subsidiaries — extends the actor map beyond deposit-taking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member list page; annual refresh.
queries_used: Slovensko asociácia "obchodníkov s cennými papiermi" OR "správcovských spoločností" SASS AOCP členovia

candidates.source_name: Slovenská asociácia správcovských spoločností (SASS)
candidates.why_relevant: Asset-management association founded 1998; reported ~7 regular and ~18 associate members. Publishes fund-industry data and cooperates with AOCP and SBA — sector-level disclosure for the investment arms of SK banking groups.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of members and statistics sections.
queries_used: Slovensko asociácia "obchodníkov s cennými papiermi" OR "správcovských spoločností" SASS AOCP členovia

candidates.source_name: Asociácia poskytovateľov spotrebiteľských úverov (APSÚ)
candidates.why_relevant: Represents the main SK consumer-credit providers since 1998; all members hold an NBS licence. Files formal comments (stanoviská/pripomienky) in legislative processes on SLOV-LEX and to NRSR — a direct, dated record of non-bank lender sector positions and of regulatory pressure on credit products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl site news/members; additionally query SLOV-LEX pripomienkové konanie for the association's name to capture position papers.
queries_used: Asociácia poskytovateľov spotrebiteľských úverov apsu.sk členovia stanovisko

candidates.source_name: Asociácia finančných sprostredkovateľov a finančných poradcov (AFISP)
candidates.why_relevant: Association of financial intermediation/advisory leaders — the distribution layer through which a large share of SK banking and insurance products is sold. Positions and member lists reveal distribution-channel economics and regulatory conflicts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of news and member pages.
queries_used: fintech asociácia Slovensko členovia platobné inštitúcie združenie

candidates.source_name: Slovenská asociácia poisťovní (SLASPO)
candidates.why_relevant: Insurance sector association (listed by NBS); relevant to the 'both sectors' scope through bancassurance and insurtech overlap, and its ombudsman arm publishes consumer-dispute material. Note: the NBS directory exposes the ombudsman URL rather than the main SLASPO domain, which must be confirmed separately.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; resolve the canonical SLASPO domain first.
queries_used: bankový ombudsman Slovenská banková asociácia inštitút výročná správa

candidates.source_name: Asociácia doplnkových dôchodkových spoločností (ADDS) & Asociácia dôchodkových správcovských spoločností (ADSS)
candidates.why_relevant: Pension pillar associations named by NBS; their members are largely subsidiaries of the same banking groups, and their statistics/positions track long-term savings flows competing with bank deposits.

candidates.source_name: Asociácia slovenských inkasných spoločností (ASINS)
candidates.why_relevant: Debt-collection association; its members are the counterparties buying/servicing NPL portfolios from SK banks and consumer lenders. Membership list is a pointer to the NPL-servicing actor set, invisible in bank-side directories.

candidates.why_relevant: E-commerce association whose member list covers merchants, logistics and payment-acceptance-adjacent vendors — the acquiring/checkout demand side of SK payments. Publishes aktuality, statutes and expert-committee activity; has an EN members page.

candidates.why_relevant: 100+ member private ICT sector association (founded 1999); membership includes the systems integrators and technology vendors serving SK banks and payments infrastructure — the vendor-side actor map that banking associations do not expose. negative_findings.description: No annual report (výročná správa) of the Slovak Banking Association was found published on sbaonline.sk. Fetches of the homepage, /o-nas/ and /novinka/ surfaced press releases, statistics/analyses and project pages, but no annual-report archive or downloads section.
negative_findings.result_summary: SBA appears not to self-publish an annual report; its statutory financial statements would instead sit in registeruz.sk under IČO 30813182.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The workstream expects association annual reports as a direct disclosure type; for SK banking the substitute route is the state register, not the association site.

negative_findings.description: ALS SR site navigation (fetched) exposes members, statistics (SK/EU), documents, press releases, glossary, FAQ, videos and a vehicle register — but no annual report or publications section.
negative_findings.result_summary: Leasing association publishes recurring statistics but no annual report on its own domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Statistics are the valuable asset here; do not budget collection effort for a non-existent report series.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak payment service provider / e-money institution association was found. Searches in Slovak for a payments-specific association returned only the two general fintech bodies (Slovenská FinTech asociácia, FINAS) and the e-commerce association SAEC.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-industry self-regulation in SK appears to be handled inside SBA's expert commissions (14 commissions, 200+ specialists, including a payments area) rather than by a standalone PSP association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments intelligence for SK must be sourced from SBA commissions plus the fintech associations; searching for a nonexistent SK equivalent of a payments association would waste cycles.

negative_findings.description: The 'bankový ombudsman SBA' — a term still widely used in SK banking glossaries — was abolished by the SBA members' assembly on 31 May 2018 and replaced from 1 July 2018 by the Inštitút alternatívneho riešenia sporov SBA.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching 'bankový ombudsman' retrieves mostly obsolete bank-glossary pages, not a live source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A noisy legacy term; collection must target institutars.sk, and any 'bankový ombudsman' material dated after mid-2018 should be treated as stale.

negative_findings.description: Several association URLs were taken from the NBS directory and search results without being fetched: institutars.sk, adss.sk, adds.sk, apsu.sk, afisp.sk, aocp.sk, ass.sk, saec.sk, itas.sk/clenovia, amcham.sk, sopk.sk, asins.sk, finas.sk. Some are listed by NBS as http-only, which may indicate outdated directory entries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as candidates with confidence scores below the fetched sources; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents overstating verification; http-only entries in a regulator directory are a common signal of redirects or moved sites, not of dead sources.

negative_findings.description: The NBS professional-associations directory lists the Slovak Insurance Association (SLASPO) via its ombudsman domain poistovaciombudsman.sk, and lists the asset-management association as 'www.ass.sk' while search results use the SASS branding. Canonical domains for these two bodies were not confirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two association identities need a disambiguation pass before scheduled collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Registering the wrong canonical domain would silently produce empty crawls.

negative_findings.description: SBA membership counts differ across its own pages: the EN about page states 29 members (25 banks), the SK about page states 24 members, and the members directory enumerates 24 (20 full + 4 associate). Sector coverage is stated as ~99% (SK) vs 100% by assets (EN).
negative_findings.result_summary: Member counts are not internally consistent; the enumerated directory is the most reliable of the three.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any headline figure quoted from SBA must cite the enumerated member list and its retrieval date, not the prose about-page numbers.

coverage_gaps.description: The SBA's 14 expert commissions (odborné komisie, 200+ banking specialists, covering payments, security, accounting, regulation, legal) were referenced on /o-nas/ but their individual pages, outputs and membership were not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the SBA odborné komisie subpages and any standards/projects they publish (e.g. push-payment notification standard, ESG framework); these are the closest thing SK has to payments-industry position papers.

coverage_gaps.description: Member directories of ALS SR, FINAS, Slovenská FinTech asociácia, AOCP, SASS, APSÚ, ASINS, SAEC and ITAS were located as URLs but their actual member entities were not extracted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated extraction pass over these directory URLs to build the consolidated SK banking/payments/vendor actor map, then feed each extracted entity into the A1 IR/annual-report scouting cells.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association coverage is thin: only SBA (/en/), FINAS (/en/), SAEC (/en/), ITAS (/en/), AmCham and EBF offer EN material. Most position papers, statistics and legislative comments exist in Slovak only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Slovak as the mandatory primary collection language for this cell and budget machine translation; do not rely on the EN mirrors, which are shorter and update later (the SBA EN about page already carries stale member counts).

coverage_gaps.description: Employer confederations (Republiková únia zamestnávateľov, AZZZ SR) — which typically include SBA or individual banks and issue tripartite economic positions, e.g. on bank levies — were queried but returned no usable results in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted Slovak queries for 'RÚZ stanovisko banková daň' and 'AZZZ SR členovia finančný sektor' and check whether SBA appears in their member lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Compliance/AML and card-scheme-adjacent professional bodies in Slovakia (e.g. a Slovak compliance circle, internal auditors' institute, ACAMS-style chapters) were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Slovak queries for 'compliance asociácia Slovensko banky', 'Slovenský inštitút interných audítorov', 'AML združenie Slovensko' in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No check was made of whether association press-release and statistics archives are paginated back in time or whether historical PDFs remain reachable (relevant for ALS SR monthly statistics and SBA /novinka/ history).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe pagination depth and, where archives are truncated, plan Wayback Machine backfill for alssr.sk statistics and sbaonline.sk news.

brief: Slovakia's banking and payments self-regulatory layer is narrow but well-mapped: NBS itself publishes a directory of the nine recognised financial professional associations, and Slovenská banková asociácia (~24 members, near-total sector coverage, EBF and EPC member since 1996) is the single dominant voice, publishing press releases, payment-card statistics and standards but no annual report of its own. The richest pointer assets are the member directories — SBA, ALS SR, AOCP, SASS, APSÚ, ASINS, plus the two fintech bodies (Slovenská FinTech asociácia and FINAS) and the vendor-side ITAS and SAEC lists — which together enumerate banks, leasing companies, consumer lenders, NPL servicers, fintechs and the technology suppliers behind them. Because associations rarely publish their own reports or full position papers, the substitute primary channels are registeruz.sk for their statutory financial statements and SLOV-LEX pripomienkové konanie for their dated, named legislative positions. Collection must be Slovak-first: the English mirrors are sparser, later, and in SBA's case already internally inconsistent on basic membership figures.
